patch.value: Host SDK allows stale item writes after lease takeover

PR 179 thread PRRT_kwDOSYpI8s6vNO6H is valid in pinned pm CLI SDK 2026.10.15. A real non-git tracker reproduction uses one-second item leases and configured automatic stale takeover: a second native writer commits while the first mutateItem callback is suspended; the stale first call then returns successfully and overwrites the second value. mutateItemWithDeferredHistoryContext persists after the callback without an atomic lease-ownership or document-revision fence. Fix belongs to the host SDK; queue rules forbid editing upstream pm-cli in this workstream. This package cannot honestly certify protection after lease expiry until that host contract is fixed.
The host atomically refuses stale item persistence when lease ownership or document revision changed, preserving the newer value and allowing safe transaction reconciliation.

Standalone node --test test/repros/sdk-lease-overrun.ts: 0 passed / 1 failed, exit 1. takeoverCompleted=true; staleWriterRefused=false; newerValuePreserved=false. The newer committed value was replaced by the stale writer. Synthetic fixture only; no existing tracker data was used.
